'''Wispeth''' was a female<ref name="GCG" /> [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWI 135">{{InsiderCite|135|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!}}</ref> She shared the name of a [[Wispeth (legend)|princess]] in Ewok mythology.<ref name="GCG" />
